test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

(P) the research paper analyses

(Q) the relationship between diet and

(R) disease and the importance of

(S) exercise in maintaining good health
solution:
The correct answer is** "PQRS."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Part P introduces the **subject (The research paper analyses) **to the sentence. So, this must be the first part.
 
• The next part is the pair QR as it introduces the next part with **"the relationship between diet and (Q) disease and the importance of."**
 
• The next part is the object of the sentence, i.e. the part S.
 
• The sentence follows the logical order of presenting the subject first, followed by the action (analysis) and then the object (relationship between diet and disease and the importance of exercise in maintaining good health).
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct sentence: 

*The research paper analyses (P) the relationship between diet and (Q) disease and the importance of (R) exercise in maintaining good health (S).*
